pretreatments.description: Microwave pretreatment (MP) - Microwave irradiation at different power levels (90 W - 720 W) and treatment times (1 - 60 min) using an IFB-30SC2 microwave oven.
Surfactant microwave pretreatment (SMP) - Microwave pretreatment combined with 1:50 ratio of GMM and water and different SDBS concentrations (0.005 to 0.5 g/g TS) at an optimal MP conditions.
